adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`’s `onError`, `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` will virtually always produce a non-empty string (even if `err.data?.code` is undefined it becomes e.g. `"undefined: ..."`), making `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), ...)` a dead fallback as the finding states. Also, the code passes `err.message` directly into `t(...)`, which assumes `err.message` is a translation key; if it’s an arbitrary error string from tRPC/runtime, users may see untranslated keys/raw messages. Both behaviors are directly evidenced in the diff.
